evals.name: verify-a-documented-claim
evals.prompt: docs/fivb-data-quirks.md says 89% of played rows share their rank with another team. Is that still true? Tell me what you find and update the doc if it needs it.
evals.expected_output: Measures against the published tree rather than trusting or hand-waving; recognises this as a dated investigation finding rather than a count that must be refreshed.

evals.name: new-published-tree-test
evals.prompt: Add a regression test that no published graph node has a `first` season later than its `last`. Put it wherever it belongs.
evals.expected_output: Asserts against web/public/v1 rather than a fixture, guards against vacuity, and verifies the test can actually fail before keeping it.

evals.name: editorial-boundary
evals.prompt: The ten Rio de Janeiro events from 1987 to 1996 were the de facto world championships of that era - everyone in the sport treats them that way. Should we retier them as world-champs so they show up properly on player cards?
evals.expected_output: Declines to reclassify, explaining that tiers come from FIVB's own Type and that promoting them would mint World Championship medals no other source recognises; points at documenting instead.
